profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Preventice Solutions
profile.summary:
Software engineer with experience in all stages of software development, including Agile development with automated testing and continuous delivery pipelines. Areas of focus include web application development, web security, REST API's, and creating highly available cloud services. 


Technical Skills
Languages: Java, Node.js, C++, C, Delphi, PL1, and many others
Web: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSP’s, XSLT, DOJO, REST api’s (implementing and using), Swagger
App Servers: WebSphere, Tomcat, WebLogic, DataPower Security Gateway
Cloud: Cloud Foundry and Docker containers with Kubernetes
Authentication & Security: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML 2.0, web security and OWASP
DataBase: JPA, JDBC, ODBC, DB2, Redis, Mongo, AS/400, Essbase,

positions.title: Security Architect
positions.description:
Worked on multiple projects at IBM, in multiple roles and using different skills over the years. 
Focus areas include
- WebSphere and Liberty based application servers
- Client UI with DOJO (I don't recommend that)
- Node.js application servers
- DataPower gateway appliance 
- Kubernetes cloud deployment of web servers

Roles and responsibilities include
- technical lead and mentor for small groups of 2-4 people
- security architect responsible for Watson Analytics Authentication and Authorization
- Architect, designed, estimate and implemented numerous features on various projects.

Technical skills include
- OAuth, OIDC and SAML authentication
- XSLT and DataPower
- Node, Java, html/css, REST apis, JDBC, DB2, Redis, 
- WebSphere, Liberty, Tomcat and WebLogic application servers

Most recent project involved a IBM cloud deployment of a web application where my responsibility was the kubernetes deployment and security gateway. See: 
https://console.bluemix.net/docs/services/dynamic-dashboard-embedded/index.html#overview-of-dynamic-dashboard-embedded

positions.title: Master Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a number of different projects in different roles for SPSS.  These transitioned directly from ShowCase to SPSS when ShowCase was acquired. 
Some projects include
- Continued to maintain the Windows client Report Writer product
- Developer on a Data modeling repository written in Java, and running on WebSphere

positions.title: Additional Relevant Experience
positions.description:
Software Engineer at ShowCase Corp. 
Intern at IBM
AS/400 System administrator, Mankato State University

volunteerExperiences.description:
Active fire fighter for 12 years on the all volunteer department.
Duties include training and responding to incidents such as car & vehicle fires, accidents, flood protection and community outreach. 
Was secretary or treasure for most of those years.

Mentor and core team member for IBM's Lego Education outreach program. 
- As a core team member, I helped developer the Lego projects and curriculumn. We also organized and implemented the final competition event that drew 50-100 teams from area schools. 
- As a mentor I volunteered at Pine Island MS/HS through fall semester, working with students to learn the robotic building and programming.
